name: zotero-project-papers
title_zh: Zotero 文献库里的顶会顶刊检索器，你点名才动
tagline_zh: 没明说『找论文』就绝不多嘴。你问技术问题它不引文献，但一旦你说『查顶会』，它从Zotero项目里翻出真论文。
tagline_en: Silent unless you explicitly ask for papers. When you do, it digs real references from your Zotero projects—no.
desc_en: Use only when the user explicitly asks to find, search, survey, retrieve, or reference academic papers/literature; explicitly asks for top-conference/top-journal papers; explicitly asks to use Zotero or the project's reference papers; or explicitly asks for an answer grounded in actual papers. Do not activate merely because a technical question could benefit from citations, because the user asks w
why_zh: 它把『要不要查文献』的决定权交还给你，只在指令明确时启动，避免AI自作主张引一堆不相关来源。
why_en: It respects your intent—no unsolicited citations. Searches only within your Zotero projects, ensuring every reference is real.
limit_zh: 仅当用户明确要求查找/检索/综述/引用论文或顶会顶刊时才激活；不处理模糊请求（如『帮我看看这个技术』）。
limit_en: Activates only on explicit paper-related requests. Searches only existing Zotero items, no web search. Outputs a list, no full-text or notes.
title_en: Top-conference paper finder in your Zotero, only on request
